newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Kolinska 1996 net profit falls 13 pct.
newsitem.headline: Kolinska 1996 net profit falls 13 pct.

text.p: Slovenian food producer Kolinska said on Wednesday that 1996 net profit fell 13 percent to 560 million tolars ($3.7 million) but that it expects 1997 net to rebound to 750 million tolars.
"In view of the fact...conditions in our main foreign markets Serbia and Bosnia are still not sufficiently stable, we feel our results are satisfactory," general manager Lojze Dezelak told Reuters.
Last year Kolinska invested some $7.75 million in Rogaska Slatina health resort and has forecast spending even more this year as the firm plans to set up a new electronic system.
In 1995, Kolinska paid an unchanged dividend of 83 tolars.
In late trading on Wednesday, Kolinska's share price was 2,200 tolars, down 0.5 percent on the day.
